propositions: reads return [] instead of store_uninitialized for a directory that exists but lacks .git or has an unresolvable HEAD
the read-side initialization guard uses bare os.path.isdir, which cannot distinguish an empty initialized store from a broken or mid-clone store
the write side already checks .git presence, creating read/write disagreement about store usability
an existing empty initialized store must continue to read [] per existing contract test, so the discriminator must be git HEAD resolvability rather than directory emptiness
a store mid-clone (directory present, HEAD unresolvable) must raise store_uninitialized on reads, not mask as []

fixing the read predicate to check .git presence and HEAD resolution widens store_uninitialized for present-but-unusable stores, requiring audit.server to log this case instead of silently blanking it
